title: earth/highest.json: Highest now (session 8, part 126). Big cities (Natural Earth's populated places of 1 million people or more, engine/cities.json) ranked by the middle (median) of their open PM2.5 monitors within 25 km this hour, the same monitors the adjusted field uses; only cities with 3 or more. Written every hour; named by earth.json's `highest`.

at.description: The monitors' hour: the newest reading among the monitors used.

rule.description: The rule in the page's words.

rows.description: Highest first; a tie on the median goes to the city with more monitors.

median.description: The middle of the city's monitors, whole µg/m³ (an even count: the mean of the middle 2).

band.description: The median's band on NEA's hourly PM2.5 scale.

fewer_than_3.description: Big cities with fewer than 3 such monitors within 25 km (0, 1 or 2).
